vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2322: Harden host dashboard-port guard: a workspace/UAT agent can seize primary :3011 via OVERDECK_WORKSPACE_DASHBOARD_ALLOW_PRIMARY

plan.title: Harden host dashboard-port guard: a workspace/UAT agent can seize primary :3011 via OVERDECK_WORKSPACE_DASHBOARD_ALLOW_PRIMARY
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: A workspace/UAT agent can seize the operator's primary dashboard port (:3011) by setting OVERDECK_WORKSPACE_DASHBOARD_ALLOW_PRIMARY=1. The guard in src/dashboard/server/config.ts:78-93 honors the override unconditionally — even for a boot from a workspaces/feature-* checkout — and the refusal error message itself names the env var, teaching the refused agent exactly how to bypass the guard. This hijacked host :3011 twice (2026-07-03 via the PAN-1917 UAT agent, 2026-07-07 via the PAN-2405 test agent), violating the single-deacon invariant and causing operator-facing outages.
narratives.Proposal: Gate the override so it is ignored whenever isWorkspaceRepoRoot(identity.repoRoot) is true (it remains functional for the documented operator use: a non-workspace host-side peer binding the port when the canonical dashboard is deliberately stopped). Scrub the env var name from the thrown/logged refusal message. Make tests/unit/dashboard/config.test.ts deterministic by mocking getDashboardIdentity (the suite currently passes from a workspace worktree only because beforeEach sets the override — a crutch this fix kills), and lock the new behavior with explicit override-gating tests. Document the override as operator-only in the pan-dashboard-restart dev-skill instead of the runtime error. Exact before/after code is in .pan/drafts/PAN-2322.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Redirecting UAT/test agents to workspace-container dashboards (issue FR-3) — follow-up issue, referenced from pan done notes
- Any change to shouldRefuseHostDashboardPort() in src/dashboard/server/identity.ts (correct as-is; container-awareness from PAN-2298 must remain behaviorally identical)
- Devcontainer template changes (already PORT=3013)
- How the server is launched (dashboard-node22-only rule; no run-target changes)
- Process probing / liveness checks in the guard (no execSync in server code)
- Scope of open siblings PAN-2292, PAN-1416, PAN-1444

autoDecisions.summary: Adopt the committed PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-2322.md) verbatim as the plan; no interactive discovery questions asked.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD was authored and committed on main (9d2c53409c) with all file/line references verified against HEAD; this session re-verified config.ts:78-93, identity.ts:23-25/45-67, config.test.ts:60/69/154, and the SKILL.md Modifiers section — all match. Every decision the template requires is already made in the doc.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the override with `&& !isWorkspaceRepoRoot(identity.repoRoot)` in config.ts rather than changing shouldRefuseHostDashboardPort().
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the guard predicate pure and untouched (PAN-2298 container behavior preserved byte-for-byte); the override is a config-layer concern and this is the PRD's stated decision (surgical-changes rule).

autoDecisions.summary: Fix test determinism by partially mocking identity.js (getDashboardIdentity only) instead of keeping the blanket env override in beforeEach.
autoDecisions.rationale: After FR-1 the blanket override no longer unblocks workspace-run suites, so the suite would go red from any workspaces/feature-* worktree (NFR-1); mocking identity makes results independent of where the suite runs while leaving shouldRefuseHostDashboardPort real.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the override functional for non-workspace peer boots; document it only in sync-sources/dev-skills/pan-dashboard-restart/SKILL.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator escape hatch (deliberately-stopped canonical dashboard) is a real use; moving its documentation from the agent-facing runtime error to operator docs satisfies FR-2/FR-3 without losing the affordance.

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/config.ts (guard at lines 73-93): add isWorkspaceRepoRoot to the existing import from './identity.js'; change the overrideAllowed computation to `process.env['OVERDECK_WORKSPACE_DASHBOARD_ALLOW_PRIMARY'] === '1' && !isWorkspaceRepoRoot(identity.repoRoot)`; remove the final sentence of the refusal message so neither the thrown ServerConfigError nor the console.error line names the env var; add the operator-escape-hatch comment. Use the exact before/after snippet in .pan/drafts/PAN-2322.md WI-1. Do not modify src/dashboard/server/identity.ts.
